reason: Default build: correct as machine code. Recount: PHA/PLA/TAX gone saves 9; ground_rows TYA/ADC zp/TAX (7) becomes LDA zp/ADC #/STA abs/STA abs (13), -6; two DEX a turn gone, 4 a turn over 11 turns (Y=&15, edge written) or 10 (Y=&13, runway): 47 or 43 cycles, 9 on the bridge path. No page crossings either way (gc + t*t + Y stays in ground_columns' page; the patched low byte cannot carry: ASSERT LO+30 < &100 holds at &0C53, &0BB5, &DFDA); BPL and both BNEs stay within &18xx; C = 0 out (no carry), V = 0 out in every layout (&53/&B5/&DA + 0..9 no signed overflow), A out = ground_columns+t*t+0 as before, X out t instead of t*t-1 but both callers' next JSR (use_viewport_*_as_edge) loads X; operands written just before each use, only these two writers; no BBR/BBS etc. Assembled on a scratch copy: default build moves no symbol (region 64 + SKIP 2 = 66 as before). REFUTED on the gameplay builds (GAMEPLAY_ANY, which drop the IF GAMEPLAY_ANY = 0 padding): the region grows 63 -> 64 bytes, so the claimed 'bytes 0' and 'no data moves' are false there. Built `make gameplay` old and new: 604 symbols move up by 1 byte, &1886 to the free block, including tables (ground_edge_*, game_over_text, mover_type_scoring_table(_tens), enemy_helicopters_min/max_x_low, movers_min/max_x_low, offsets_to_numbers_table), against the grind rule 'no data moves'; and page crossings change: in check_if_mover_is_on_edge (run per mover per scroll column) BNE calculate_sprite_address_for_mover_on_edge (&1BF9) and BCC leave_with_carry_clear_1ff9 (&1BFD) start crossing a page (+1 each when taken); sky_room's second BCC ok (&2FFD) and CMP offsets_to_numbers_table,X (&2EFF -> &2F00) stop crossing (-1). The candidate did not count or mention any of this. Fixable by keeping the gameplay layout (or an agreed acceptance that gameplay builds move), not as written.
